notes:
Overview:
- Vellichor runs a vertical SaaS KB for mid-market support orgs (help centers, in-app answers).
- Primary pain: search relevance degrades at scale; want embeddings + reranker to boost precision on top-5 answers.
- Indexing scale: ~8-12M docs (knowledge articles + threaded support transcripts).
- Query profile: bursty but sustained high QPS (100-250 qps average peak per region). Cost sensitivity high — they want <$0.003/query (including rerank).

Technical requirements / constraints:
- Prefer hosted API for speed-to-market; will evaluate Dedicated if cost or latency needs dictate.
- Need reranker stage: dense retrieval (approx 50 results) + efficient re-rank with a smaller cross-encoder to avoid big latency hit.
- 95th percentile latency target: <=150ms for single-query path (including retrieval + rerank).
- Warm cache expected; many queries repeat prefixes (customer search flows).
- Embedding dimension: currently 1536, considering 768 to trade cost/latency.
- Index ops: weekly bulk re-index + incremental real-time patches.

Security / compliance:
- SOC2 mandatory; SSO via SAML required for admin console.
- Audit logging for model calls and payload metadata; retention controls for transcripts (30-90 days).
- KMS support for key wrapping on sensitive vectors desired.

POC design discussed:
- 7-day run with 10M-embeddings dataset (subset of production).
- Traffic profile simulation: ramp to 150 qps sustained, burst to 300 qps for 2m.
- Two pipeline variants: (A) standard dense-retrieval + 1-stage cross-encoder rerank (cheaper, slightly slower); (B) two-tier: fast sparse/dense hybrid + lightweight reranker (lower latency).
- Metric targets: recall@10, MRR, token cost per query, 95th latency, cost per 10k queries.

Sales notes / quotes from call:
- "We need search that doesn’t slow down when we grow — relevance now OK at low volume but falls apart at scale."
- Team cares about predictable pricing and ability to throttle or route traffic to cheaper variants during off-peak.

Open questions (client):
- What quantization/embedding packing options can Redwood Optimize recommend to hit <150ms at 150 QPS?
- Can we provide a sample cost model for 10M index + 150 QPS (monthly estimate)?
- How are reranker costs attributed (per-token vs per-invocation)?

- Prepare perf harness and sample dataset ingestion guide (Engineering)
